body:
25.10
Ordered on October 4th, got a confirmation email on 12th, no follow-up after that. No notices, no shipment info, no updates on the site, nothing. Really sad that this happened, it was the only vendor who reliably shipped to my country.
-----
29.10 edit.
The support has just contacted me that they have problems with their courier service and are working to resolve that. So, the good news is we're not forgotten about, but the delay in communication is a bit nerve-wracking. 
3 stars for now, I'll edit it again when I receive my order
Paid on Oct 11, order "received" on Oct 17 and no news nor response since.
2 months waiting for shipping and nothing, mails do not get replies anymore either, really cool.

Four months of nothing, GG.
Best case scenario the package got lost, but there has been little to no communication.
shipping took about 2.5 weeks to the EU and everything was as it should. the packaging was unfortunately extremely inappropriate but it's not as if i was surprised, otkph is known for it after all.
